title: pallenis hierochuntica
intro: Pallenis hierochuntica, commonly known as Palestine daisy, is a flowering plant species native to the Middle East and Mediterranean regions. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Pallenis hierochuntica include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and treat respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
